investigation.supportedCause: Weak application and convenience-driven composition, not missing brand guidance. V3 renderer uses one orthographic pose, fixed heading coordinates, persistent pale field, pair-of-dice slots and rectangular weighted proof. Earlier internal review explicitly accepted these repetitions as continuity after sampled correctness/spacing corrections, underweighting subject material impact, amount of simultaneous bookkeeping and whole experience.
investigation.counterevidence: V3 did preserve faces, change opponents, demonstrate weights and close the circle, and full decoded chronology genuinely caught a transition defect. Thus the failure was not absent evidence or universal prohibition of diagrams; the editorial acceptance of fixed slots was too permissive.
investigation.smallestProcessCorrection: Use the existing separate rendered review earlier on opening and mixed-proof prototypes; QA timestamps must include each actual mechanism/branch state, not only narration cue midpoints. Record whether numbers/heading updates carry the development instead of object/evidence changes. No new gate, framework, aesthetic whitelist or numeric diversity scoring.

alternatives.treatment: Spatial rounded-die tabletop theatre with face-token wheels and sequential outcome beads
alternatives.strength: Fixed geometry, material/number fidelity and meaningful pose/scale changes; visibly derive each route before the combined count.
alternatives.tradeoff: Code-authored illustration and stylized explanatory overlays, not filmed real dice. Selected on conceptual/technical feasibility, subject to actual prototype inspection.

alternatives.treatment: Filmed custom physical dice with overhead macro close-ups
alternatives.tradeoff: No actual custom dice/recording environment/rights-cleared footage acquired; cannot claim empirical fairness or use a few staged rolls as probability evidence.

alternatives.treatment: Flat illustrated face matching with minimal probability typography
alternatives.strength: Excellent count legibility, low modeling risk.
alternatives.tradeoff: Could preserve V3presentation impression if arranged as diagrams; face tokens remain useful inside spatial treatment.

alternatives.treatment: New color palette and camera zoom applied to V3
alternatives.tradeoff: Would retain the owner-rejected heading/panel structure; rejected as superficial.

nonGeneralizations: No universal dark palette,3D mandate, always-moving camera, duration quota or ban on useful diagrams.
limits: Actual sampled renders and exact prior feedback read; no historical continuous playback, subjective audio or real-device/feed test.
